doc: write_map on a 24x20 f64 coverage made of rounding ties: every (k + 0.5) / 255 (np.round is half-to-even: 127.5 -> 128, 126.5 -> 126; the product c * 255 stays in the input dtype), a third of them one f64 ulp below and above, the 16-bit ties (m + 0.5) / 65535, negative zero, values out of [0, 1] and infinities (np.clip first). Decoded files: the 16-bit master (I;16 PNG, north-up, round(c * 65535)), the 8-bit preview (L PNG, north-up, round(c * 255)) and the raw R8 gunzipped (south-up: the preview's rows reversed). Exact: integers.
